fact: The CNRC portal lets entrepreneurs create a company online without visiting the administrations, with a single registration to all of them.
The CNRC says the single registration gives the firm a common identification number, issued within three days of approval by CNRC, the tax directorate (DGI), CNAS, CASNOS and ONS.

The CNRC's company-creation page says a firm's registration in the commerce register can be made online through its dedicated company-creation portal, with fees paid online by CIB or Edahabia card, and name reservation can also be requested online.
